$comment: Known, accepted debt. scripts/lint-tokens.mjs fails on anything not listed here, and also fails when an entry here stops being true — so this file can shrink but never grow silently. Every entry needs a reason.

knownContrastFailures.reason: brand.700 on white is 3.39:1. Passes AA for large and bold text and for UI components, but not for small body text. Accepted because the brand blue is fixed; links must therefore carry an underline so colour is not the only signal. Retuning the brand ramp is tracked for v2.
Same brand.700 limitation as text-link. Use at 18px+, or bold at 14px+.
White on brand.700. Primary button labels are bold 14px+, which meets the AA large-text threshold. Do not use this pairing for small regular-weight text.

yellow.600 on white fails AA outright. The caution ramp is too light at every step to carry text on white. Pair icon-caution with text-primary instead. Scheduled to be fixed when caution is retuned and renamed to warning in v2.
White on yellow.600. The token name promises a contrast-safe pairing it cannot deliver; use text-primary on caution fills. Fixed by the v2 caution retune.
yellow.600 on yellow.100. Same defect as above; use text-primary. Fixed by the v2 caution retune.
Below the WCAG 1.4.11 non-text minimum of 3:1. A caution icon must never be the only signal — always pair it with text.
Inherits the caution ramp defect. Pair with text.
Inherits the caution ramp defect. Pair with text.

$orphanComment: Primitives with no semantic role. Deliberately unexposed: they exist in the scale for completeness or for future roles, and product code must not reach for them. A NEW orphan is a lint failure — add the role, or add it here with a reason.
